description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'LocalResourceRepository' that manages Android application resources, including resource retrieval, cache invalidation, and integration with IDE features. It includes methods for accessing resource files, handling resource items, and tracking modifications.

classes.name: LocalResourceRepository
classes.description: An abstract class managing Android resource data, providing resource retrieval, cache invalidation, and modification tracking functionalities.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the resource repository.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the repository is disposed.

methods.name: isFramework
methods.description: Indicates whether this repository is a framework resource repository.

methods.name: addParent
methods.description: Adds a parent repository to this repository.

methods.name: removeParent
methods.description: Removes a parent repository from this repository.

methods.name: invalidateItemCaches
methods.description: Invalidates cached resource items for specified resource types.

methods.name: getModificationCount
methods.description: Returns the current modification count (generation) of the resource data.

methods.name: getMatchingFile
methods.description: Retrieves the matching resource file for a given virtual file, resource type, and configuration.

methods.name: getMatchingFile (deprecated)
methods.description: Deprecated method to get matching resource file by name.

methods.name: isScanPending
methods.description: Checks if a scan is pending for a given PsiFile.

methods.name: getItemPsiFile
methods.description: Returns the PsiFile source for a given resource item.

methods.name: getItemTag
methods.description: Returns the XmlTag for a resource item in value files.

methods.name: getViewTag
methods.description: Returns the view tag name associated with a resource item.
